title: A finite standard-open free cover makes a module finite projective
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $N$ an $R$-module. If there are finitely many elements $f_1,\dots,f_r\in R$ generating the unit ideal such that each localization $N_{f_i}$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization-away] is a finite free $R_{f_i}$-module, then $N$ is a finite projective $R$-module [def-weil-pbc-projective-module].

proof.text: The finite standard-open free-cover criterion gives that $N$ is finitely presented and flat [lem-sc-affine-standard-cover-finite-presentation-flat].

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00NX (lemma-finite-projective), implications (7) => (4) => (5) => (1) (finite locally free gives finitely presented by Lemma lemma-cover; flatness is checked locally by Lemma lemma-flat-localization)

proof.text: A finitely presented flat module is projective [lem-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-flat-module-projective]. Together with its finite presentation, this is precisely a finite projective module [def-weil-pbc-projective-module].
